hypothesis: Paid target eta labels can identify a useful residual function direction under the retained source covariance, without knowing true target support.
single_change: For eta only, add delta * e_j e_j^T to the original source coefficient covariance, delta >= 0. Select at most one nonintercept direction j from the existing 68-function public dictionary.
preserved: Source covariance, source coefficient means, intercept, per-candidate discrepancy, dictionary normalization, paid query paths and all f/g models. Learned eta retains its two original components and initial equal weights; the same selected j and delta apply to both.
fit: Choose j and delta by training-only marginal likelihood, including the delta=0 model; marginalize the original eta components. The generic source control gets the same correction family. Use rank-one determinant/solve updates to avoid refactoring covariance for each function. No target truth, support, verifier outcomes or held-out labels enter fitting.
validation: Reuse A3's exact candidate-group holdouts and old scores. Refit both direction and scale inside every training fold; hold out all repeated observations at the candidate and score their joint predictive density.
scoring: Report all five strata for both priors and both prefixes, with paired seed gains and nominal bootstrap intervals. Primary endpoint is 24-batch learned-prior grouped predictive log score; 8-batch results diagnose early-data behavior.
recommendation_replay_gate: Proceed only with broad held-out predictive improvement and no material regression in compatible regimes. A gain restricted to one chosen stratum, or a clear shared-structure loss, stops recommendation replay. Predictive improvement alone does not authorize a new closed-loop search.
limitations: Empirical direction/scale selection does not integrate hyperparameter uncertainty; nested validation tests this selection procedure. One extra direction is a bounded diagnostic, not full target support learning. Retained query paths were generated by the old optimizer, so held-out scores do not establish prospective or deployment gains.
numerical_fit: One component: exact rank-one optimum for every direction, including zero. Two components: 65 log(1+delta) nodes per direction and bounded refinement of grid maxima, including boundary intervals. Per-component exact optima give a data-derived upper delta bound and an evidence upper bound used to skip directions that cannot beat the current best. This is numerical marginal ML, not a formal global-optimization guarantee.
